gates.detail: Stage-A head 0f634ef... is only read; Stage-B writes use a separate result directory/branch.
N=3 is retained only as R3_CONTROLLER_SPECIFIC_ALIAS_CANDIDATE.
The atlas covers every positive integer R symbolically and R=1..64 explicitly.
R1 is audited and passes the nontrivial aligned-recurrence gate.
R2 has no aliases for any N and remains in the atlas.
R3 is not a winner; its alias set is compared with all R.
R6 exact alias set {1,2,4} is retained and not rewritten as a sharp threshold.
For fixed N, changing R can create or remove alias; first descending alias also moves with R.
D1/V1/HD1 endpoint survivors are scale-down classified rather than discarded.
Noninverse returns fail D0 and are not counted as positive recurrence.
Equal endpoint packet counts are never used as recurrence evidence.
All conditions are divisibility, integer counts, exact rationals, or coefficient extraction.
General-R symbolic theorem precedes finite regression box.
Coordinates are I0 only; no forbidden geometric object is theorem-critical.
